stories.headline: In 2005, villagers mistook a stray female Sumatran rhino for a shape-shifting pig. Now she and her daughter are both pregnant
stories.snippet: Ratu, a Sumatran rhino rescued from a village in 2005, and her daughter Delilah are both pregnant, with 34 to 47 left in the wild. On Tuesday, September 20, 2005, at 4 a.m., a Sumatran rhino was seen in the neighborhood of Braja Asri village, about 0.6 miles (1 kilometer) from the boundary of Way Kambas National Park in Sumatra.

box1.why: Last rhinos need whole crew to save

box2.why: Kill monster, capture, or leave wild

box3.why: Night beast panic plays vividly live

box4.why: Tracker, calmer, speaker, protector fit easily

box5.why: Fear, capture, escape allow many endings

box6.why: Rhino mistaken for shape-shifting pig stuns

box7.why: Villagers fear magic beast at edge

box8.why: Slay demon pig or save rare animal

stories.one_sentence_setup: In a Sumatra village, a supposed shape-shifting pig threatens the village and a species' survival is at stake.
stories.dilemma: Treat the beast as an evil spirit to drive off or as a rare animal to protect.
